brief: A ledger standing upright on the shelf, so all you see is its SPINE: the narrow back edge where the title goes, like any book on a bookshelf. Draw a tall thin rectangle, roughly 6 to 8 px wide and 14 px tall, standing on the bottom of the canvas, with one or two lighter bands across it where a label would sit. One outline, one mid tone for the leather, one band colour: three or four colours. Draw it in a neutral brown; the game tints each ledger a different hue. Nine of these stand side by side on the shelf, so the shape must read as a book at a glance.
